name: web-space-pitch-slides-with-planets-mars-horizon-and-flow-diagram
title: Pitch slides floating over a starfield and Mars horizon: planets over a plant-fibre photo, a process flow and pain points
whatItIs: A black starfield with a glowing red Mars horizon and three slides stacked over it: a photo slide of insect wings with an Earth globe and a pink cell orb beside 'Tandem Repeat is solving the sustainability problem of the $3T fashion industry', a black flow-diagram slide with small icons and a crop-field photo, and a black slide listing pain points in fashion with a row of icons.
whatItMeans: Ambitious and scientific; a planetary backdrop lifts a sustainability pitch to a big-picture story.
techniques: Float slides over a space photograph.
Show the flow with tiny line icons.
Keep slides black with white type.

vocabulary.definition: Slides shown floating over a photograph.
A round photo used like a planet.
Steps connected with lines and icons.
A list of problems with icons.
